We need to compare two yes/no questions.

Question1: "O Veto nº 28 ao PL 920/2023 deve ser derrubado?" => Should Veto 28 to PL 920/2023 be overturned? This is about a specific veto on a specific bill.

Question2: "O governo federal deve garantir previsão orçamentária permanente para o Fundo de Calamidade Pública e para ações de prevenção de desastres, em vez de depender exclusivamente de medidas provisórias?" => Should the federal government guarantee permanent budgetary provision for the Public Calamity Fund and disaster prevention actions, instead of relying exclusively on provisional measures?

These are different issues. One is about a veto on a bill; the other about budgetary guarantee for a fund. Not same question. So relation = DIFFERENT.
